subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
outcomes: Read a survey report and understand its diagrams.
Know what each paragraph of a report does.
Use while and however to contrast facts in your own report.

tf.s: 453 students answered the survey “Young people and the environment”.
Planting trees was the most popular way to help the environment in the survey.
tf.why: Planting trees was the least popular (9%); recycling was the most popular.

tf.s: Paragraph three of the report explains what the results show.
A report should include a lot of the writer’s own opinions.
tf.why: A report presents only the facts.

tf.s: “However” and “while” are used to contrast information.
tf.why: Great! They show a difference between two facts.

tf.s: Diagrams help you see the survey answers quickly.
tf.why: Yes, that is why reports use diagrams.

tf.s: “Firstly, secondly, in conclusion” show the order of information.
In the survey, 24% said recycling and 32% said saving energy.
tf.why: It was 32% recycling and 24% saving energy.

tf.s: Paragraph one of the report gives the conclusion.
tf.why: Paragraph one says what the survey was about.

tf.s: In the saving water survey, 386 students answered.

boxes.q: How old were the students in the first survey?
What was the most popular answer in the first survey?

o: says what the survey was about

boxes.why: While contrasts two facts in one sentence.

boxes.q: My sister wants to help the environment. ___, she doesn’t pick up her rubbish.
boxes.why: However starts a sentence that contrasts.

boxes.q: Which word starts the last paragraph?
What is the most popular way to save water in the AB survey?
Which is a good title for a report?
boxes.why: A report title tells the topic clearly.

boxes.q: What phrase can introduce what the results mean?
boxes.why: This survey shows… explains the results.

hunt.q: Contrast word to start a sentence

mcq.q: What does paragraph one of the report do?
o: Says what the survey was about

mcq.q: What was the least popular way to help the environment?
Which words show the order of information in a report?
o: Once upon a time, the end

mcq.q: Why do reports often use diagrams?
o: You can see the answers quickly.
mcq.why: Diagrams show information at a glance.

o: 42% said protecting their homes. However, only 9% said not using plastic.
42% said protecting their homes however only 9% however.
mcq.why: However starts a new sentence with a comma after it.

mcq.q: Which sentence uses “Most students…” correctly with the survey data?
o: Most students (92%) said it is important to help endangered animals.
Most students (9%) said it is important.
mcq.why: Most means more than half, like 92%.

mcq.q: Complete: “Many students said recycling, ___ only a few said planting trees.”
mcq.why: While joins two contrasting facts in one sentence.

mcq.q: Should your report include your own opinion?
o: No – a report presents only the facts.
Yes – a report is all about opinions.
No – a report has no facts.

mcq.q: Which sentence belongs in paragraph three?
o: This survey shows that young people care about the environment.
The survey was about the environment.
mcq.why: Paragraph three explains what the results show.

mcq.q: Which is a correct checklist item for a report?
o: It has a good introduction, results and a conclusion.
It has a story with characters.
mcq.why: These are the three parts of a report.
